title: Give Up Your Selfishness, And You Shall
summary: The shabad does not leave doubt at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: like water mingling with water, you shall merge in absorption
lifeApplication: Return to one clear line before reopening every question at once. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.
